scope: Explicitly selected related experiments for four original targets that remain unavailable. Not original-task success.

tasks.numeric_scope: Measured healthy/planet-gear/sun-gear classification on SNU cutouts; no ring-gear or safety target.
tasks.adapted_question: Classify each measured SNU vibration observation as healthy, planet_gear or sun_gear using only the supplied training/development records. Report classification metrics and limitations. Ring-gear damage, physical safety, load margins and compliance are unmeasured and remain unknown.
limitations: Uses SNU rather than the original PlanetaryPdM source.
No ring-gear damage class or authenticated safety/AGMA/ISO compliance labels.
Whole source recordings are separated, but physical rig and gear reuse remains possible.
Development lacks a healthy record; final speed and load changes are confounded.

tasks.numeric_scope: Publisher-annotated trend classification on a separately frozen EngineMT-QA ten-record input; original synthetic template is not evaluated.
tasks.adapted_question: Using the supplied ten-record numerical EngineMT-QA observations, predict the publisher qualitative condition category and failure-probability bin annotation. The bin is an annotation category, not a calibrated physical failure probability. Do not use the unrelated historical template values as the experiment input.
limitations: The original template is replaced by different publisher N-CMAPSS-derived source observations.
Selected source IDs are disjoint from all existing training/development/case records; physical engine independence remains unverified.
Scores publisher categorical annotations only; actual failure risk, causal diagnosis and maintenance advice are not validated.
